crossBoardTopology.principle: 两大板块物理隔离交易(OLTP)，统一契约打通分析与选用(OLAP/同步)；跨板块交互必须流畅、标准一致、易维护

foundationMasterDb.role: single source of truth for master/reference data: tenant tree, dealer, store, identity, brand-registry, audit, product_module registry

enablementDb.role: diagnosis/CRM/BIM transactions and documents for 500+ dealer tenants

brandProductDbs.form: per-brand independent online product DB (system of record) + content/DAM

analyticsWarehouse.role: cross-board aggregated analytics; read-only; de-identified; never on an OLTP primary

rules: no cross-board direct DB connection and no cross-board JOIN
all cross-board interaction goes through published OpenAPI contracts + unified event envelope (versioned via schema registry)
master data is written only by the foundation; boards hold read-only replicas or CDC subscriptions
brand product DB is the authoritative source; product-catalog syncs a read-only selectable catalog to 瑞诺瓦 via API/CDC (PRD 4.5 tier-1 verified)
analytics flows one-way via CDC/ELT into the warehouse; HQ sees aggregated/de-identified only

standards.globalIds: tenant_id/dealer_id/store_id/product_id/brand_id are platform-wide identical; master IDs minted by foundation
standards.sharedDataDictionary: amount unit, currency, UTC timestamps, enums, admin-region codes defined once and referenced by all DBs
standards.migration: versioned expand-contract zero-downtime migrations gated in CI

industrialOps.oltpOlapSplit: per-DB primary + read replica; reporting on replica/warehouse only
industrialOps.ha: primary-replica + automatic failover; per-board connection pooling (pgbouncer)
industrialOps.dr: multi-AZ, defined RPO/RTO, PITR + periodic restore drills
industrialOps.security: encryption at rest + PII column-level encryption + audit; board-2 RLS; analytics de-identified
industrialOps.extractable: namespace-extractable per board/product domain for future split or standalone deploy

acceptance: master data single-writer proven by test
HQ analytics sourced from warehouse, cross-tenant plaintext unreachable (tested)
HA failover + PITR restore drills evidenced
